cv:
Rita Santos
Software engineer and tech lead with professional experience building distributed systems, event-driven
architectures, and backend microservices.
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Staff Software Engineer / Tech Lead
CloudScale | 2021-Present (3 years)
Leading system architecture for event-driven backend services and API platforms.
Re-architecting monolithic services into microservices using Go, Python, and Apache Kafka.
Mentoring engineers on code quality and technical design.
Managing AWS cloud infrastructure and containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes.
Senior Backend Engineer
FinTech Global | 2018-2020 (3 years)
Developing REST and gRPC microservices in Go and Python.
PostgreSQL database schema design and query optimization.
EDUCATION
M.Sc. in Informatics and Computing Engineering
FEUP (2010-2015)
TECHNICAL SKILLS
Languages: Go, Python, SQL, Bash
Architecture & Systems: Microservices, Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Redis
Cloud & Tools: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Git
